title: Activity
personal: “{name}” is a personal activity: it has no regime, so no statement. It splits the flows in <link>Analysis</link>.

noBusiness.description: invoices, collections and fiscal year statement
noBusiness.body: No business activity declared. In <link>Settings</link>, switch an activity to “business” to give it its fiscal year, its invoices and its rules.

setup.oneStep: One step and the statement fills in.
setup.twoSteps: Two steps and the statement fills in.

rules.title: Its rules
rules.why: What it owes, with its source and its calendar: this is what fills the provisions, the reserve and the schedule.

accounts.title: Its accounts
accounts.why: The accounts it runs on make its cash, and so what it can pay you.

caveats.toReview: {count, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}} to recheck
caveats.extended: {count, plural, one {# extended} other {# extended}} for lack of a new text
caveats.tail: {caveats}: their amounts are the least certain on this screen.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: what to declare and pay, overdue first

newInvoice.label: Invoice
newInvoice.title: Record an invoice
newInvoice.description: What the invoice says: invoiced is not collected, the collection is recorded when the money arrives.

stats.chargesHint: {expenses} of deductible expenses · {levies} of contributions and taxes paid
stats.payableHintShared: cash − everything owed on these accounts − due payments
stats.payableHint: cash − reserve − this month’s due payments
stats.paidHint: transfers to an account outside the activity

months.title: By month
months.description: what came in, and what is left of it
months.chartLabel: By month: what came in, the charges paid, the net
months.noDeductibleExpenses: This regime deducts no actual expense: what left the accounts is in Expenses by category.

payable.title: To pay yourself
payable.description: the activity’s cash, minus what is owed and not yet paid
payable.noAccount: no account declared on this activity
payable.reserveHint: what is owed, rule by rule
payable.sharedReserveHint: what is owed on the shared accounts
payable.sharedReserveUnreadable: what is owed on the shared accounts, except {names}, which has an unreadable rule
payable.pastYear: What you can pay yourself is read on the current fiscal year: the cash is today’s, not this fiscal year’s. On this fiscal year, {amount} was paid out.

payout.noOwnAccount: This activity runs on no account: say so on its sheet, in Settings, to pay yourself.
payout.noOutsideAccount: This activity runs on all your accounts: there is no personal account to pay yourself into.
payout.hint: opens the transfer to an account outside the activity, amount editable
payout.hintEmpty: nothing available: the reserve and due payments cover the cash
payout.title: Pay yourself
payout.description: A transfer from the activity to a personal account. It changes neither the net nor what is owed: it takes the money out of the activity.

outstanding.title: Pending invoices
outstanding.description: “Collected” records the income on the account that received the money
outstanding.empty: Nothing pending: everything invoiced has been collected.
outstanding.overdue: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} overdue
outstanding.editDescription: Fix what was entered wrong. Income already collected on it keeps its link.
outstanding.confirmBody: {label}. It leaves the pending invoices and keeps its dates. An invoice already collected, even partly, cannot be canceled: detach the linked income first.

ranks.settlementNote: dashed: paid to a rule, deducted from the net except what is collected to be passed on

thresholds.title: Watched thresholds
thresholds.description: where the activity stands, and what changes beyond

invoices.title: This fiscal year’s invoices
invoices.count: {count, plural, one {# invoice issued} other {# invoices issued}}

form.name: Name
form.jurisdictionPlaceholder: Where the activity is carried out
form.accounts: Accounts · one account can serve several

list.empty: No activities. Everything counts as personal.

fiche.intro: What is already filed under this activity stays there. The type and the taxable event can no longer change once a rule or an invoice exists.
fiche.policyAll: Every expense of the activity is deductible, except those checked here.
fiche.policyNone: No expense of the activity is deductible, except those checked here.
fiche.reopenBody: The activity accepts movements again. Its history does not change.
fiche.closeBody: No movement can be declared on it after this day. The history stays whole, and a new regime is a new activity.
